fields.description: Weekly issue containing local commentary and columns including "Women's Notebook" (Won R. Phillips) and an editorial on Miami landlords and rent gouging, linking housing costs to tourism and the upcoming American Legion convention. Includes discussion of New Deal politics and public utilities (Louis McHenry Howe; Henry L. Doherty/Cities Service), assorted local notes and gossip items, extensive radio program schedules (WIOD/WQAM), horse-racing coverage and advertisements for "Jockey Jimmy's" betting tips, and numerous local business advertisements and classifieds for Miami and nearby areas.
